   *Canadian brand offering contemporary office environments, including desks and panels.*

   *Sub-brand focusing on European markets with similar design heritage as Knoll.*

   *Japanese brand blending functionality with Japanese design aesthetics.*

   *Swiss brand featuring high-end chairs (e.g., Eames designs) and office spaces.*

10. **Emeco**  
    Website: [emeco.net](https://www.emeco.net)  
    *Famous for the Navy Chair and sustainable, durable furniture.*

11. **Allermuir**  
    Website: [allermuir.com](https://www.allermuir.com)  
    *UK-based brand crafting collaborative and flexible office environments.*

12. **BDI**  
    Website: [bdiusa.com](https://www.bdiusa.com)  
    *Modernist desks, storage solutions, and tech-integrated furniture.*

13. **Boss Design**  
    Website: [boss-design.co.uk](https://www.boss-design.co.uk)  
    *UK-focused offering ergonomic office seating and dynamic workspaces.*

14. **Orangebox**  
    Website: [orangebox.co.uk](https://www.orangebox.co.uk)  
    *British brand for privacy pods, acoustic partitions, and modular furniture.*

---

### **Sustainability & Ergonomics**
15. **Turnstone** (by Steelcase)  
    Website: [turnstonefurniture.com](https://www.turnstonefurniture.com)  
    *Budget-friendly, modern designs for small businesses and startups.*

16. **Vari**  
    Website: [varidesk.com](https://www.varidesk.com)  
    *Innovative standing desks and height-adjustable workstations.*

17. **OFM**  
    Website: [ofmfurniture.com](https://www.ofmfurniture.com)  
    *Affordable chairs, desks, and workstations for small offices and homes.*

---

### **Retailers with In-House Brands**
18. **IKEA Business**  
    Website: [ikea.com/business](https://www.ikea.com/us/business/)  
    Swedish retailer offering cost-effective office furniture under the IKEA brand.

19. **Safco**  
    Website: [safcofurniture.com](https://www.safcofurniture.com)  
    *Offers ergonomic chairs, desks, and storage solutions for budget-conscious buyers.*

---

### **Specialty and Emerging Brands**
20. **3D Office**  
    Website: [3doffice.com](https://www.3doffice.com)  
    *Known for modular, eco-friendly office furniture.*

21. **Kemble Interiors (KI)**  
    Website: [kiincorp.com](https://www.kiincorp.com)  
    *Focus on education, healthcare, and corporate spaces with durable, stylish designs.*

22. **Inwin** (Taiwan)  
    Website: [inwin.com.tw](https://www.inwin.com.tw)  
    *Taiwanese brand with innovative furniture for offices and hospitality.*

---

This list includes a mix of global giants, regional specialists, and niche brands across affordability spectrums. For more localized options, explore regional directories or check sustainability certifications like **B Corp** or **Forest Stewardship Council (FSC)** for eco-friendly choices.
